text: Next, set estimation model (EM) used within closed-loop simulation framework. helper function setup_em() prepares necessary inputs estimation model given simulation year replicate. uses SPoRC::simulation_data_to_SPoRC() convert simulation output correct input structure SPoRC model. general, EM follows structure introduced Getting Started vignette. represents **single-area, single-sex, single-fishery, single-survey model configuration. fishery survey fleets modeled logistic selectivity. Recruitment follows mean recruitment formulation, model fit : Catches Fishery age length compositions Survey age compositions Additionally, survey index fit prior catchability (q) stabilize estimation.
code: #' Setup Estimation Model Inputs for Gulf of Alaska Dusky Rockfish #' #' Prepares the estimation model input list for a given simulation year #' and replicate within the SPoRC closed-loop simulation framework. #' #' @param sim_env Simulation environment generated by `Setup_sim_env()`. #' @param y Integer. Current simulation year index. #' @param sim Integer. Simulation replicate index. #' #' @return A fully configured EM input list suitable for fitting with `fit_model()`. setup_em <- function(sim_env, y, sim) {    # Extract simulation data for current year and replicate   sim_data <- SPoRC::simulation_data_to_SPoRC(sim_env, y, sim)    # Initialize model dimensions   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Dim(     years = 1:y,     ages = 1:sim_env$n_ages,     lens = 1:sim_env$n_lens,     n_regions = sim_env$n_regions,     n_sexes = sim_env$n_sexes,     n_fish_fleets = sim_env$n_fish_fleets,     n_srv_fleets = sim_env$n_srv_fleets,     n_pop = sim_env$n_pop,      verbose = FALSE   )    # Configure recruitment model   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Rec(     input_list = input_list,     do_rec_bias_ramp = 1,  # Enable bias ramp (no lognormal bias correction)     bias_year = rep(length(input_list$data$years), 4),     sigmaR_switch = 1,  # Switch from early to late sigmaR in first year     ln_sigmaR = array(-0.1068576, dim = c(2, input_list$data$n_pop, input_list$data$n_regions)),  # Early and late sigma values     rec_model = "mean_rec",     sigmaR_spec = "fix",  # Fix early and late sigmaR     init_age_strc = 1,  # Geometric series for initial age structure     ln_global_R0 = log(2.7),  # Starting value for mean recruitment     t_spawn = 0  # Spawn timing   )    # Configure biological parameters   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Biologicals(     input_list = input_list,     WAA = sim_data$WAA,     MatAA = sim_data$MatAA,     fit_lengths = 1,     SizeAgeTrans = sim_data$SizeAgeTrans,     AgeingError = sim_data$AgeingError,     M_spec = "fix",  # Fix natural mortality at 0.07     Fixed_natmort = array(0.07, dim = c(       input_list$data$n_pop,       input_list$data$n_regions,       length(input_list$data$years),       length(input_list$data$ages),       input_list$data$n_sexes     )),     addtocomp = 0.00001   )    # Configure movement and tagging (no tagging used)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Tagging(input_list = input_list, use_conv_fish_tagging = 0)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Movement(     input_list = input_list,     use_fixed_movement = 1,     Fixed_Movement = NA,     do_recruits_move = 0   )    # Configure fishery catch and fishing mortality   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F(     input_list = input_list,     ObsCatch = sim_data$ObsCatch,     UseCatch = sim_data$UseCatch,     Use_F_pen = 1,     sigmaC_spec = "fix",     ln_sigmaC = sim_data$ln_sigmaC,     ln_sigmaF = array(log(sqrt(1/2)), dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, input_list$data$n_seas, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets))   )    # Configure fishery indices and compositions   input_list <- Setup_Mod_FishIdx_and_Comps(     input_list = input_list,     ObsFishIdx = sim_data$ObsFishIdx,     ObsFishIdx_SE = sim_data$ObsFishIdx_SE,     UseFishIdx = sim_data$UseFishIdx,     ObsFishAgeComps = sim_data$ObsFishAgeComps,     ObsFishLenComps = sim_data$ObsFishLenComps,     UseFishAgeComps = sim_data$UseFishAgeComps,     UseFishLenComps = sim_data$UseFishLenComps,     ISS_FishAgeComps = sim_data$ISS_FishAgeComps,     ISS_FishLenComps = sim_data$ISS_FishLenComps,     fish_idx_type = c("none"),     FishAgeComps_LikeType = c("Multinomial"),     FishLenComps_LikeType = c("Multinomial"),     FishAgeComps_Type = c("agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1"),     FishLenComps_Type = c("agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1")   )    # Configure survey indices and compositions   input_list <- Setup_Mod_SrvIdx_and_Comps(     input_list = input_list,     ObsSrvIdx = sim_data$ObsSrvIdx,     ObsSrvIdx_SE = sim_data$ObsSrvIdx_SE,     UseSrvIdx = sim_data$UseSrvIdx,     ObsSrvAgeComps = sim_data$ObsSrvAgeComps,     ObsSrvLenComps = sim_data$ObsSrvLenComps,     UseSrvAgeComps = sim_data$UseSrvAgeComps,     UseSrvLenComps = sim_data$UseSrvLenComps,     ISS_SrvAgeComps = sim_data$ISS_SrvAgeComps,     ISS_SrvLenComps = sim_data$ISS_SrvLenComps,     srv_idx_type = c("biom"),     SrvAgeComps_LikeType = c("Multinomial"),     SrvLenComps_LikeType = c("Multinomial"),     SrvAgeComps_Type = c("agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1"),     SrvLenComps_Type = c("agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1")   )    # Configure fishery selectivity and catchability   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q(     input_list = input_list,     fish_sel_model = c("logist2_Fleet_1"),     fish_fixed_sel_pars_spec = c("est_all"),     fish_q_spec = c("fix")   )    # Configure survey selectivity and catchability with prior   srv_q_prior <- data.frame(     region = 1,     block = 1,     fleet = 1,     mu = 1,     sd = 0.447213595   )    input_list <- Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q(     input_list = input_list,     srv_sel_model = c("logist2_Fleet_1"),     srv_fixed_sel_pars_spec = c("est_all"),     srv_q_spec = c("est_all"),     Use_srv_q_prior = 1,     srv_q_prior = srv_q_prior,     t_srv = array(0, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, input_list$data$n_seas, input_list$data$n_srv_fleets))   )    # Configure data weighting   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Weighting(     input_list = input_list,     Wt_Catch = 1,     Wt_FishIdx = 1,     Wt_SrvIdx = 1,     Wt_Rec = 1,     Wt_F = 1,     Wt_Tagging = 0,     Wt_FishAgeComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,                                         input_list$data$n_sexes, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),     Wt_FishLenComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,                                         input_list$data$n_sexes, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),     Wt_SrvAgeComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,                                        input_list$data$n_sexes, input_list$data$n_srv_fleets)),     Wt_SrvLenComps = array(0, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions, length(input_list$data$years), input_list$data$n_seas,                                        input_list$data$n_sexes, input_list$data$n_srv_fleets))   )    return(input_list) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: part closed-loop simulation process, estimates estimation model (EM) passed projection model, together defined management procedure (MP), derive catch advice. following helper function can embedded within closed-loop simulation generate catch advice EM outputs. details Do_Population_Projection() function operates applied provided Deriving Reference Points, Catch Advice, Projections vignette. general, following function extracts estimates terminal year condition population projections derive catch advice.
code: #' Run Population Projection #' #' Performs forward projection of the population using assessment model outputs #' and management procedure specifications. #' #' @param sim_env Simulation environment #' @param obj Fitted assessment model object #' @param reference_points Calculated reference points #' @param asmt_data Assessment data list #' @param mp_config Management procedure configuration #' @param y Current year index #' #' @return Projection results including projected catch run_projection <- function(sim_env, obj, reference_points, asmt_data, mp_config, y) {    n_proj <- mp_config$proj_opt$n_proj_yrs    # Extract terminal year numbers-at-age   tmp_terminal_NAA <- array(     obj$rep$NAA[,, y, ,, ],     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, asmt_data$n_seas, length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )   tmp_terminal_NAA0 <- array(     obj$rep$NAA0[,, y, ,, ],     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, asmt_data$n_seas, length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )    # Replicate biological parameters for projection years   tmp_WAA <- array(     rep(asmt_data$WAA[,, y, ,, ], each = n_proj),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_seas, length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )    tmp_WAA_fish <- array(     rep(asmt_data$WAA_fish[,, y, ,, , ], each = n_proj),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_seas, length(asmt_data$ages),             asmt_data$n_sexes, asmt_data$n_fish_fleets)   )    tmp_MatAA <- array(     rep(asmt_data$MatAA[,, y, ,, ], each = n_proj),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_seas, length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )    tmp_fish_sel <- array(     rep(obj$rep$fish_sel[,, y,, , , ], each = n_proj),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_seas,             length(asmt_data$ages),  asmt_data$n_sexes, asmt_data$n_fish_fleets)   )    tmp_natmort <- array(     rep(obj$rep$natmort[,, y, , ], each = n_proj),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )    # Extract terminal fishing mortality   tmp_terminal_F <- array(     obj$rep$Fmort[, y,, ],     dim = c(asmt_data$n_regions, asmt_data$n_seas, asmt_data$n_fish_fleets)   )    # Extract recruitment history   tmp_recruitment <- array(     obj$rep$Rec[,, 1:y],     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, length(1:y))   )    # Replicate sex ratio for projection years   tmp_sexratio <- array(     replicate(n = n_proj, obj$rep$sexratio[,, y, ]),     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_sexes)   )    # Replicate movement matrix for projection years   tmp_Movement <- array(     dim = c(asmt_data$n_pop, asmt_data$n_regions, asmt_data$n_regions, n_proj, asmt_data$n_seas,             length(asmt_data$ages), asmt_data$n_sexes)   )   for (proj_yr in 1:n_proj) {     tmp_Movement[, ,, proj_yr, ,, ] <- obj$rep$Movement[, ,, y, ,, ]   }    # Execute population projection   proj_results <- SPoRC::Do_Population_Projection(     n_proj_yrs = n_proj,     n_regions = sim_env$n_regions,     n_ages = sim_env$n_ages,     n_sexes = sim_env$n_sexes,     sexratio = tmp_sexratio,     n_fish_fleets = sim_env$n_fish_fleets,     do_recruits_move = sim_env$do_recruits_move,     recruitment = tmp_recruitment,     terminal_NAA = tmp_terminal_NAA,     terminal_NAA0 = tmp_terminal_NAA0,     terminal_F = tmp_terminal_F,     natmort = tmp_natmort,     WAA = tmp_WAA,     n_pop = sim_env$n_pop,     WAA_fish = tmp_WAA_fish,     MatAA = tmp_MatAA,     fish_sel = tmp_fish_sel,     Movement = tmp_Movement,     f_ref_pt = reference_points$f_ref_pt,     b_ref_pt = reference_points$virgin_b_ref_pt * mp_config$reference_points_opt$B_x,     HCR_function = mp_config$proj_opt$HCR_function,     recruitment_opt = mp_config$proj_opt$recruitment_opt,     fmort_opt = mp_config$proj_opt$fmort_opt,     t_spawn = sim_env$t_spawn,     bh_rec_opt = mp_config$proj_opt$bh_rec_opt   )      return(proj_results) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: Next, define functions determine catches constrained translate fishing mortality within closed-loop simulation. general, helper functions establish feedback catch advice operating model. first function applies management rules constraints (.e., caps) total allowable catch (TAC). constraints applied user-specified function catch_opt_func, modifies input catch advice based management procedures defined later. next function converts (possibly constrained) TAC corresponding fishing mortality rate (Fmort) used operating model. function uses bisection algorithm find value fishing mortality achieves specified TAC region fleet combination. updated Fmort values stored simulation environment use next time step closed-loop cycle.
code: #' Apply Catch Constraints #' #' Applies management procedure catch constraints (e.g., caps) to projected catch. #' #' @param tmp_TAC Array of projected TAC values #' @param catch_opt_func Function defining catch constraints #' #' @return Modified TAC array with constraints applied apply_catch_constraints <- function(tmp_TAC, catch_opt_func) {   for (j in 1:dim(tmp_TAC)[3]) {     tmp_TAC[1,, j,1, ] <- catch_opt_func(catch = tmp_TAC[1,, j,1, ])   }   return(tmp_TAC) } #' Convert TAC to Fishing Mortality #' #' Uses bisection method to find fishing mortality rate that achieves target TAC. #' #' @param sim_env Simulation environment #' @param tmp_TAC Target total allowable catch #' @param y Current year index #' @param sim Simulation replicate index #' @param assessment_years Vector of assessment year indices #' #' @return Updated simulation environment with new fishing mortality rates tac_to_fmort <- function(sim_env, tmp_TAC, y, sim, assessment_years) {    # Find most recent assessment year   last_assess_year <- max(assessment_years[assessment_years <= y])   tac_year_index <- y - last_assess_year + 1    # Create grid of region-fleet combinations   rf_grid <- expand.grid(     r = seq_len(sim_env$n_regions),     f = seq_len(sim_env$n_fish_fleets)   )    # Solve for F that achieves target catch for each region-fleet combination   tmp_f <- mapply(     function(r, f) {       SPoRC::catch_to_F_singlefleet(         f_guess = 0.05,         catch = tmp_TAC[1, r, tac_year_index, 1, f],         NAA = sim_env$NAA[1, r, y + 1, 1, , , sim],         WAA = sim_env$WAA[1, r, y + 1, 1, , , sim],         natmort = sim_env$natmort[1, r, y + 1, , , sim],         fish_sel = sim_env$fish_sel[1,r, y + 1, 1, , , f, sim]       )     },     r = rf_grid$r,     f = rf_grid$f   )    # Update fishing mortality in simulation environment   sim_env$Fmort[, y + 1, 1, , sim] <- array(tmp_f, dim = c(sim_env$n_regions, sim_env$n_seas, sim_env$n_fish_fleets))    return(sim_env) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: MPs define catch advice generated applied within closed-loop simulation. MP defined includes rules reference point calculation, control rule shape, catch implementation. helper functions specify shape control rules used across different MPs. threshold rule reduces fishing mortality spawning biomass declines biomass reference point, constant rule maintains fishing mortality fixed rate regardless biomass status. list defines specific MPs used example. configuration represents different management strategy, varying strongly responds changes biomass whether catch caps imposed. MP following components example: Reference point options (reference_points_opt), specify biological reference points calculated (e.g., target spawning potential ratio, biomass thresholds). Projection options (proj_opt), define harvest control rule (HCR) recruitment fishing mortality handled projections. Catch options (catch_opt), optionally constrain catches according management limits (e.g., catch caps). Users flexibility modify extend structure fit specific modeling objectives.
code: #' Threshold Harvest Control Rule #' #' Implements a threshold HCR where F is reduced linearly as biomass declines #' below the target biomass reference point. #' #' @param x Current biomass #' @param frp Fishing mortality reference point (target F) #' @param brp Biomass reference point (target biomass) #' @param alpha Minimum biomass threshold (as fraction of brp) #' #' @return Fishing mortality rate HCR_threshold <- function(x, frp, brp, alpha = 0.05) {   stock_status <- x / brp    if (stock_status >= 1) {     f <- frp   } else if (stock_status > alpha) {     f <- frp * (stock_status - alpha) / (1 - alpha)   } else {     f <- 0   }    return(f) }  #' Constant Harvest Control Rule #' #' Implements a constant catch HCR where F remains at the reference level #' regardless of stock status. #' #' @param x Current biomass (unused) #' @param frp Fishing mortality reference point (target F) #' @param brp Biomass reference point (unused) #' @param alpha Minimum biomass threshold (unused) #' #' @return Fishing mortality rate (constant at frp) HCR_constant <- function(x, frp, brp = 0, alpha = 0.05) {   return(frp) } assess_freq <- 2           # Assessment frequency (every 2 years)  mp_list <- list(    # 1. No fishing   # Serves as a baseline scenario. No assessment, projection, or catch is applied.   f0 = list(     skip_assessment = TRUE,     reference_points_opt = NULL,     proj_opt = NULL,     catch_opt = NULL   ),    # 2. F40% with B40% threshold   # The assessment is performed and reference points are calculated based on an SPR of 40%.   # A threshold rule (B40%) is applied, where F declines linearly as biomass drops below 40% of B_SPR.   f40_thresh = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = 0.4     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_threshold,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = NULL) catch   ),    # 3. F40% constant   # Similar to f40_thresh, but no biomass threshold is applied.   # Fishing mortality remains constant at F40%, regardless of biomass status.   f40_const = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = NULL     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_constant,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = NULL) catch   ),    # 4. F40% hybrid: B60% threshold with 3k ton catch cap   # Combines a precautionary threshold (B60%) with a hard catch cap (3,000 tons).   # This MP reduces F more aggressively at lower biomass and constrains annual catches   # to prevent excessive harvest in high-recruitment years.   f40_hybrid = list(     skip_assessment = FALSE,     reference_points_opt = list(       n_avg_yrs = 1,       SPR_x = 0.4,       calc_rec_st_yr = 3,       rec_age = 4,       type = 'single_region',       what = "SPR",       B_x = 0.6     ),     proj_opt = list(       n_proj_yrs = assess_freq + 1,       HCR_function = HCR_threshold,       recruitment_opt = 'mean_rec',       fmort_opt = 'HCR',       bh_rec_opt = NULL     ),     catch_opt = function(catch, prev_catch = NULL, catch_cap = 3000) {       pmin(catch, catch_cap)     }   ) )

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: core closed-loop simulation involves iterating years replicates simulate population dynamics, assessments, management feedback. simulation year, population updated according biological processes, recruitment, fishing mortality. feedback period reached, management procedures applied based latest assessment results , cases, skipped MP specifies fishing (e.g., F = 0). Assessment model inputs prepared using setup_em helper, model fit available data (via fit_model). assessment complete, reference points calculated, forward projections run, catch advice determined. Catch constraints caps can applied converting advice true fishing mortality rates used operating models next year. single-replicate loop serves building block running multiple replicates parallel, allowing us evaluate robustness performance different MPs repeated simulations.
code: #' Run Single Simulation Replicate #' #' Executes one complete closed-loop simulation replicate including population #' dynamics, assessments, and management feedback. #' #' @param sim Simulation replicate index #' @param sim_list Simulation configuration list #' @param mp_config Management procedure configuration #' @param assessment_years Vector of years when assessments occur #' @param years_to_use Vector of years with available data #' @param assess_freq Assessment frequency (years) #' #' @return List containing simulation results (SSB, catch, F, NAA) run_single_replicate <- function(sim, sim_list, mp_config, assessment_years,                                  years_to_use, assess_freq) {      # Initialize simulation environment   sim_env <- Setup_sim_env(sim_list)    # Loop through all simulation years   for (y in 1:sim_env$n_yrs) {          # Execute annual population dynamics     run_annual_cycle(y, sim, sim_env)      # Management feedback loop (after burn-in period)     if (y >= sim_env$feedback_start_yr) {       # Check if MP skips assessments (e.g., F=0)       if (!is.null(mp_config$skip_assessment) && mp_config$skip_assessment) {         if (y < sim_env$n_yrs) sim_env$Fmort[, y + 1, , , sim] <- 0       } else {         # Normal assessment and management procedure         if (y %in% assessment_years) {           # Prepare estimation model inputs           dusky_input_list <- setup_em(sim_env, y, sim)           asmt_data <- dusky_input_list$data           parameters <- dusky_input_list$par           mapping <- dusky_input_list$map            # Set indicators for unused data years to 0           asmt_data <- SPoRC::set_data_indicator_unused(             data = asmt_data,             unused_years = setdiff(1:sim_env$n_yrs, years_to_use),             what = c("FishIdx", "FishAgeComps", "SrvIdx", "SrvAgeComps", "FishLenComps", "SrvLenComps")           )            # Fit assessment model with error handling           fit_result <- tryCatch({             SPoRC::fit_model(               asmt_data, parameters, mapping,               random = NULL, newton_loops = 1, silent = TRUE             )           }, error = function(e) {             message(sprintf("Model fit failed for replicate %d in year %d: %s",                             sim, y, e$message))             return(NULL)           })            # If model fitting failed, return NA results           if (is.null(fit_result)) {             return(list(               sim = sim,               rec = NA,               ssb = NA,               catch = NA,               fmort = NA,               naa = NA,               failed = TRUE,               failure_year = y             ))           }            obj <- fit_result            # Calculate biological reference points           reference_points <- SPoRC::get_closed_loop_reference_points(             use_true_values = FALSE,             sim_env = sim_env,             asmt_data = asmt_data,             asmt_rep = obj$rep,             y = y,             sim = sim,             reference_points_opt = mp_config$reference_points_opt,             n_proj_yrs = mp_config$proj_opt$n_proj_yrs           )            # Run forward projections           proj <- run_projection(sim_env, obj, reference_points, asmt_data, mp_config, y)            # Apply catch constraints (e.g., caps)           tmp_TAC <- apply_catch_constraints(             proj$proj_Catch[1,, -1, 1, , drop = FALSE],             mp_config$catch_opt           )         }          # Convert TAC to fishing mortality for next year         if (y < sim_env$n_yrs) {           sim_env <- tac_to_fmort(sim_env, tmp_TAC, y, sim, assessment_years)         }       }     }   }    # Return successful replicate results   list(     sim = sim,     rec = sim_env$Rec[,,,sim,drop = FALSE],     ssb = sim_env$SSB[,, , sim, drop = FALSE],     catch = sim_env$TrueCatch[,, , , sim, drop = FALSE],     fmort = sim_env$Fmort[,, , , sim, drop = FALSE],     naa = sim_env$NAA[,,, , , , sim, drop = FALSE],     failed = FALSE   ) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)
text: efficiency, simulations can executed parallel across multiple management procedures replicates. run_parallel_simulations function sets parallel cluster, exports necessary functions objects, runs replicate simultaneously. Results replicate collected stored arrays spawning biomass, catch, fishing mortality, numbers--age. Users can modify custom manner extract additional results necessary unique applications.
code: #' Run Parallel Simulations #' #' Executes multiple management procedures in parallel across all replicates. #' #' @param mp_list List of management procedure configurations #' @param sim_list Simulation configuration list #' @param n_cores Number of CPU cores to use  #' #' @return List of simulation results for each management procedure run_parallel_simulations <- function(mp_list, sim_list, n_cores = max(1, detectCores() - 2)) {    # Initialize parallel cluster   cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)   registerDoParallel(cl)    # load in packages   clusterEvalQ(cl, {     library(SPoRC)     library(here)   })    # export functions in env   clusterExport(     cl,     c("sim_list", "assessment_years", "years_to_use", "assess_freq",       "setup_em", "run_projection", "apply_catch_constraints",       "tac_to_fmort", "run_single_replicate"),     envir = environment()   )    # init results storage   sim_res <- vector("list", length(mp_list))   names(sim_res) <- names(mp_list)    # loop through each management procedure   for (i in seq_along(mp_list)) {      message(sprintf(       "Running MP %d/%d: %s on %d cores with %d replicates",       i, length(mp_list), names(mp_list)[i], n_cores, sim_list$n_sims     ))      # export MP to par env     current_mp_config <- mp_list[[i]]     current_mp_name <- names(mp_list)[i]     clusterExport(cl, c("current_mp_config", "current_mp_name"), envir = environment())      # run replicates in parallel     replicate_results <- parLapply(cl, 1:sim_list$n_sims, function(sim) {        set.seed(123 + sim)         tryCatch({         run_single_replicate(           sim = sim,           sim_list = sim_list,           mp_config = current_mp_config,           assessment_years = assessment_years,           years_to_use = years_to_use,           assess_freq = assess_freq         )       }, error = function(e) {         list(error = TRUE, message = as.character(e), sim = sim)       })     })      # get dimensions from first replicate     n_regions <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$ssb)[2]     n_years <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$ssb)[3]     n_ages <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$naa)[5]     n_sexes <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$naa)[6]     n_fish_fleets <- dim(replicate_results[[1]]$fmort)[4]      # init result arrays     sim_res[[i]] <- list(       mp_name = names(mp_list)[i],       rec = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, sim_list$n_sims)),       ssb = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, sim_list$n_sims)),       catch = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_fish_fleets, sim_list$n_sims)),       fmort = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_fish_fleets, sim_list$n_sims)),       naa = array(dim = c(n_regions, n_years, n_ages, n_sexes, sim_list$n_sims))     )      # populate result arrays from replicate results     for (sim in 1:sim_list$n_sims) {       sim_res[[i]]$rec[, , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$rec[1,,,]       sim_res[[i]]$ssb[, , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$ssb[1,,,]       sim_res[[i]]$catch[, , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$catch[,,1,,]       sim_res[[i]]$fmort[, , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$fmort[,,1,,]       sim_res[[i]]$naa[, , , , sim] <- replicate_results[[sim]]$naa[1,,-n_years,1,,,1]     }    }    # reset parallel cluster   stopCluster(cl)    return(sim_res) }

title: Testing Management Procedures via Closed Loop Simulations (Dusky Rockfish)

title: Specifying a Natal Homing Model
text: Movement parameterized two seasons three populations. seasonal structure captures two distinct behavioral phases: Season 1 (dispersal): diffusive mixing, population moderate probability remaining current region, remainder spread uniformly regions. Season 2 (natal return): strong homing back natal region small rate homing natally. proportion individuals natally home, stray rate specified represent components population temporarily transfer population memerbship. default, set 0, thus, individuals stray. Rather, individuals natally home represent skipped spawning (.e., contribute spawning biomass). Note populations 1 2 different dispersal retention probabilities (0.7 vs 0.3) despite sharing natal region, creating distinct mixing dynamics two co-occurring populations.
code: sim_list$Movement <- array(   0,   dim = c(sim_list$n_pop, sim_list$n_regions, sim_list$n_regions,           sim_list$n_yrs, sim_list$n_seas, sim_list$n_ages,           sim_list$n_sexes, sim_list$n_sims) )  # Fill in movement matrix stay_prob <- c(0.7, 0.3, 0.7)  # probability of staying in current region during dispersal season disperse_prob <- (1 - stay_prob) / (sim_list$n_regions - 1)  # spread remainder equally non_natal_rate <- 0.15 # non natal homing rate  for (p in seq_len(sim_list$n_pop)) {   nr <- sim_list$natal_region[p]   for (r_from in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {      # Season 1: diffusive dispersal, mostly stay, some movement out     for (r_to in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {       prob <- if (r_to == r_from) stay_prob[p] else disperse_prob[p]       sim_list$Movement[p, r_from, r_to, , 1, , , ] <- prob     }      # Season 2: natal return with straying     for (r_to in seq_len(sim_list$n_regions)) {       prob <- if (r_to == nr) 1 - non_natal_rate * (sim_list$n_regions - 1) else non_natal_rate       sim_list$Movement[p, r_from, r_to, , 2, , , ] <- prob     }   } }

title: Discard and Retention Modeling
text: estimation model mirrors OM structure estimates key parameters: fishery selectivity (logistic), retention selectivity (asymptotic logistic), survey selectivity (logistic), catchability, recruitment deviations, dead discard rate. function encapsulates full EM setup single simulation replicate.
code: setup_em <- function(sim_obj, sim) {    # get simulation data   sim_data <- simulation_data_to_SPoRC(     sim_env = sim_obj, y = sim_obj$n_years, sim = sim   )    # Model dimensions  input_list <- Setup_Mod_Dim(     years          = 1:sim_obj$n_years,     ages           = 1:sim_obj$n_ages,     lens           = sim_obj$n_lens,     n_regions      = sim_obj$n_regions,     n_sexes        = sim_obj$n_sexes,     n_fish_fleets  = sim_obj$n_fish_fleets,     n_srv_fleets   = sim_obj$n_srv_fleets,     n_pop          = sim_obj$n_pop,     natal_region   = sim_obj$natal_region,     verbose        = FALSE   )    # Recruitment   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Rec(     input_list        = input_list,     do_rec_bias_ramp  = 0,     sigmaR_switch     = 1,     ln_sigmaR         = array(log(0.5), c(2, input_list$data$n_pop,                                           input_list$data$n_regions)),     rec_model         = "mean_rec",     sigmaR_spec       = "fix",     init_age_strc     = 1,     equil_init_age_strc = 2,     ln_global_R0      = log(5)   )    # Biologicals   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Biologicals(     input_list    = input_list,     WAA           = sim_data$WAA,     MatAA         = sim_data$MatAA,     WAA_fish      = sim_data$WAA_fish,     WAA_srv       = sim_data$WAA_srv,     fit_lengths   = 0,     AgeingError   = sim_data$AgeingError,     M_spec        = "fix",     Fixed_natmort = array(0.3, dim = c(input_list$data$n_pop,                                        input_list$data$n_regions,                                        length(input_list$data$years),                                        length(input_list$data$ages),                                        input_list$data$n_sexes))   )    # Tagging and movement (none)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Tagging(input_list = input_list, use_conv_fish_tagging = 0)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Movement(     input_list         = input_list,     use_fixed_movement = 1,     Fixed_Movement     = NA,     do_recruits_move   = 0   )    # Catch, fishing mortality, and discards   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F(     input_list     = input_list,     ObsCatch       = sim_data$ObsCatch,     UseCatch       = sim_data$UseCatch,     Use_F_pen      = 1,     sigmaC_spec    = "fix",     ln_sigmaC      = sim_data$ln_sigmaC,     ln_sigmaF      = array(log(1), dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                            input_list$data$n_seas,                                            input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),          # Discard data (discard units are biomass fractions as default)     ObsDiscard     = sim_data$ObsDiscard, # observed discards     UseDiscard     = sim_data$UseDiscard, # using discards     sigma_dmr_spec = "fix", # fixing the SD of the discard mortality rate deviations     dmr_mean_spec  = "est_all", # estimating the mean discard mortality rate     # dmr_dev_spec is left at its "fix" default here, so no annual deviations     # are estimated and dmr is the estimated mean in every year     ln_sigmaD      = sim_data$ln_sigmaD # discard time series uncertainty   )    # Fishery indices and compositions (retained + discard)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_FishIdx_and_Comps(     input_list = input_list,      # Fishery index     ObsFishIdx    = sim_data$ObsFishIdx,     ObsFishIdx_SE = sim_data$ObsFishIdx_SE,     UseFishIdx    = sim_data$UseFishIdx,      # Retained age compositions     ObsFishAgeComps  = sim_data$ObsFishAgeComps,     ObsFishLenComps  = sim_data$ObsFishLenComps,     UseFishAgeComps  = sim_data$UseFishAgeComps,     UseFishLenComps  = sim_data$UseFishLenComps,     ISS_FishAgeComps = sim_data$ISS_FishAgeComps,     ISS_FishLenComps = sim_data$ISS_FishLenComps,      fish_idx_type        = "biom",     FishAgeComps_LikeType = "Multinomial",     FishLenComps_LikeType = "none",     FishAgeComps_Type     = "agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1",     FishLenComps_Type     = "none_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1",      # Discard age compositions     ObsFishAgeComps_discard      = sim_data$ObsFishAgeComps_discard,     UseFishAgeComps_discard      = sim_data$UseFishAgeComps_discard,     ISS_FishAgeComps_discard     = sim_data$ISS_FishAgeComps_discard,     FishAgeComps_discard_LikeType = rep("Multinomial", input_list$data$n_fish_fleets),     FishAgeComps_discard_Type     = "agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1",   )    # Survey indices and compositions   input_list <- Setup_Mod_SrvIdx_and_Comps(     input_list = input_list,     ObsSrvIdx        = sim_data$ObsSrvIdx,     ObsSrvIdx_SE     = sim_data$ObsSrvIdx_SE,     UseSrvIdx        = sim_data$UseSrvIdx,     ObsSrvAgeComps   = sim_data$ObsSrvAgeComps,     ObsSrvLenComps   = sim_data$ObsSrvLenComps,     UseSrvAgeComps   = sim_data$UseSrvAgeComps,     UseSrvLenComps   = sim_data$UseSrvLenComps,     ISS_SrvAgeComps  = sim_data$ISS_SrvAgeComps,     ISS_SrvLenComps  = sim_data$ISS_SrvLenComps,     srv_idx_type          = "biom",     SrvAgeComps_LikeType  = "Multinomial",     SrvLenComps_LikeType  = "none",     SrvAgeComps_Type      = "agg_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1",     SrvLenComps_Type      = "none_Year_1-terminal_Fleet_1"   )    # Fishery selectivity: logistic for total, asymptotic logistic for retention   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q(     input_list              = input_list,     fish_sel_model          = "logist1_Fleet_1",     fish_fixed_sel_pars_spec = "est_all",     fish_q_spec             = "est_all",     ret_sel_model           = "asymplogist1_Fleet_1",     ret_fixed_sel_pars_spec = "est_all",     use_fixed_ret_sel       = 0   )    # Survey selectivity   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q(     input_list              = input_list,     srv_sel_model           = "logist1_Fleet_1",     srv_fixed_sel_pars_spec = "est_all",     srv_q_spec              = "est_all"   )    # Data weighting (no data weights used)   input_list <- Setup_Mod_Weighting(     input_list     = input_list,     Wt_Catch       = 1,     Wt_FishIdx     = 1,     Wt_SrvIdx      = 1,     Wt_Rec         = 1,     Wt_F           = 1,     Wt_Discard     = 1,     Wt_D           = 1,     Wt_FishAgeComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                        length(input_list$data$years),                                        input_list$data$n_seas,                                        input_list$data$n_sexes,                                        input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),     Wt_FishLenComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                        length(input_list$data$years),                                        input_list$data$n_seas,                                        input_list$data$n_sexes,                                        input_list$data$n_fish_fleets)),     Wt_SrvAgeComps = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                       length(input_list$data$years),                                       input_list$data$n_seas,                                       input_list$data$n_sexes,                                       input_list$data$n_srv_fleets)),     Wt_FishAgeComps_discard = array(1, dim = c(input_list$data$n_regions,                                                length(input_list$data$years),                                                input_list$data$n_seas,                                                input_list$data$n_sexes,                                                input_list$data$n_fish_fleets))   )    return(input_list) }

what: Construct a 3D sparse precision matrix over ages, years, and cohorts — Get_3d_precision
title: Construct a 3D sparse precision matrix over ages, years, and cohorts — Get_3d_precision
text: Builds sparse \((n_{\text{ages}} \times n_{\text{yrs}}) \times (n_{\text{ages}} \times n_{\text{yrs}})\) precision matrix \(Q\) Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) simultaneous autoregressive (SAR) structure across three biological dimensions: age, year, cohort (age-year diagonal). matrix constructed via path-matrix factorization \(Q = (- B)^\top \Omega^{-1} (- B)\), \(B\) encodes partial correlations \(\Omega\) diagonal variance matrix. Two variance parameterizations supported: marginal (stationary) conditional (non-stationary).

title: Construct a 3D sparse precision matrix over ages, years, and cohorts — Get_3d_precision
code: Get_3d_precision(   n_ages,   n_yrs,   pcorr_age,   pcorr_year,   pcorr_cohort,   ln_var_value,   Var_Type )

title: Construct a 3D sparse precision matrix over ages, years, and cohorts — Get_3d_precision
text: n_ages Integer. Number age classes. n_yrs Integer. Number years. pcorr_age Numeric. Partial correlation along age dimension (.e., adjacent ages within year). pcorr_year Numeric. Partial correlation along year dimension (.e., adjacent years within age). pcorr_cohort Numeric. Partial correlation along cohort diagonal (.e., \((-1, y-1)\) \((, y)\) cell). ln_var_value Numeric. Log target variance. Exponentiated internally \(\sigma^2 = \exp(\text{ln\_var\_value})\). Var_Type Integer. Variance parameterization: 0 = marginal (stationary) variance, diagonal elements \(\Omega\) solved recursively via accumulator \((- B)^{-1}\) achieve constant marginal variance \(\sigma^2\) every node (slower); 1 = conditional (non-stationary) variance, diagonal elements \(\Omega\) set \(\sigma^2\) directly (faster).

Let \(N_{p,r,,s}\) denote numbers--age \(M_{p,r,}\) denote natural mortality \(F_{r,,s}\) denote total fishing mortality (retained + dead discards) \(Z = M + F\) denote total mortality Recruitment age 1 $$ N_{p,r,1,s} = R_{0,p,r} \times sexratio_{p,r,s} $$ Within-season survival follows $$ N_{p,r,,s+1} = N_{p,r,,s}\exp(-Z_{p,r,,s}) $$ Ages advance end final season year: $$ N_{p,r,+1,1} = N_{p,r,,n_{seas}} \exp(-Z_{p,r,,n_{seas}}) $$ plus group accumulates survivors terminal age: $$ N_{^+} = N_{-1} e^{-Z_{-1}} + N_{^+} e^{-Z_{^+}} $$ Fishing mortality age decomposed retained dead discard components, summed across fleets: $$ F_{p,r,s,} = \sum_{f=1}^{n_f} F^{init}_{r,s,f} \left[ sel_{p,r,s,,f} \cdot ret_{p,r,s,,f} + sel_{p,r,s,,f} \cdot (1 - ret_{p,r,s,,f}) \cdot dmr_{r,s,f} \right] $$ \(sel\) total fishery selectivity, \(ret\) retention selectivity, \(dmr\) discard mortality rate. ### Scalar geometric-series solution movement absent, equilibrium abundance follows $$ N_a = N_1 \exp\left(-\sum_{=1}^{-1} Z_i \right) $$ plus group closed-form solution $$ N_{^+} = \frac{N_{-1} e^{-Z_{-1}}} {1 - e^{-Z_{^+}}} $$ ### Matrix geometric-series solution movement occurs, survival movement combined seasonal transition matrices: $$ \mathbf{T}_a = \prod_{s=1}^{n_{seas}} \mathbf{M}_{,s}\mathbf{S}_{,s} $$ \(\mathbf{M}\) movement transition matrix \(\mathbf{S}\) diagonal matrix survival probabilities plus group equilibrium satisfies $$ \mathbf{N}_{^+} = (\mathbf{} - \mathbf{T}_{^+})^{-1} \mathbf{T}_{-1} \mathbf{N}_{-1} $$ iterative method (init_age_strc = 0) numerically applies full seasonal population dynamics repeatedly population converges equilibrium. equilibrium derived, log-scale initial age deviations (ln_InitDevs) applied multiplicatively ages \(2,\dots,\). title: Set up movement model inputs and parameter structures — Setup_Mod_Movement
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. move_type Integer. Movement model formulation: 0 = unstructured Markov; 1 = CTMC. Default 0. do_recruits_move Integer flag. 0 = age-1 fish move (default); movement deviations CTMC rows minimum age fixed zero. 1 = recruits participate movement. use_fixed_movement Integer flag. 0 = estimate movement (default); 1 = fix movement rates Fixed_Movement map movement parameters NA. Fixed_Movement Numeric array externally supplied movement probability matrices, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. [n_regions × n_regions] slice must row-stochastic (rows sum 1). Required use_fixed_movement = 1. NA (default), identity matrix (movement) constructed internally. Use_Movement_Prior Integer flag. 1 = apply Dirichlet priors movement row probabilities; 0 = priors (default). Requires Movement_prior. Movement_prior Data frame Dirichlet prior concentration parameters. Required columns: pop, region_from, year, seas, age, sex, alpha, alpha list-column element numeric vector length n_regions giving Dirichlet concentration transitions region_from. Values near 1 uninformative; larger values concentrate prior toward equal movement. used Use_Movement_Prior = 1. Movement_popblk_spec "constant" (default, shared across populations) list integer vectors partitioning populations blocks. Example: list(c(1, 2), 3) shares parameters populations 1 2 estimates separate parameter population 3. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_ageblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining age blocks. Example: list(1:4, 5:10) creates juvenile block (ages 1-4) adult block (ages 5-10). Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_yearblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining year blocks discrete structural breaks movement. residual annual variation, use cont_vary_movement instead. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_seasblk_spec "constant" (default) list integer vectors defining season blocks. Example: list(c(1, 2), c(3, 4)) groups winter/spring summer/fall. Ignored move_type = 1. Movement_sexblk_spec "constant" (default, sex-invariant) list integer vectors defining sex blocks. Example: list(1, 2) estimates sex-specific movement independently. Ignored move_type = 1. cont_vary_movement Character string specifying structure continuous iid movement deviations added top fixed-effect movement surface. Default "none". Options: "none" deviations. "iid_y" Year-varying; shared across pop, age, sex, season. "iid_a" Age-varying; shared across pop, year, sex, season. "iid_y_a" Year \(\times\) age. "iid_y_a_s" Year \(\times\) age \(\times\) sex. "iid_y_seas_a_s" Year \(\times\) season \(\times\) age \(\times\) sex. "iid_p_y", "iid_p_a", "iid_p_y_a", "iid_p_y_a_s", "iid_p_y_seas_a_s" Population-specific analogs . Movement_cont_pe_pars_spec Character string specifying estimation process-error variance cont_vary_movement deviations. One : "none" process-error parameters; use cont_vary_movement = "none". "fix" Parameters initialized estimated; fixes     deviation variance starting value. "est_shared" Single variance estimated, shared across     dimensions. "est_all" variance parameters estimated independently,     dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. ctmc_move_dat Data frame required move_type = 1. row corresponds unique pop-region-year-season-age-sex combination. Required columns: pop, regions, years, seas, ages, sexes, plus covariate columns referenced diffusion_formula preference_formula. Projection years exceeding n_years automatically capped final estimation year prevent spline extrapolation. adjacency_mat Square numeric matrix [n_regions × n_regions] 1 indicating allowed transition 0 indicating direct connection. diagonal must 0: residency falls generator, non-zero diagonal leaves generator columns summing something zero, movement matrix loses abundance rather redistributing . fully connected matrix 1 - diag(n_regions) (note diag(1, n_regions) identity, adjacency matrix). Required move_type = 1, validated dimension, 0/1 entries, zero diagonal, least one connection. move_type = 0 fully connected matrix constructed automatically. area_r Numeric vector length n_regions giving area region, used scale CTMC diffusion rates. Required move_type = 1. Default: rep(1, n_regions). diffusion_formula R formula defining linear predictor CTMC diffusion (\(\theta\)) component (e.g., ~ bs(depth, df = 4)). right-hand-side variables must present ctmc_move_dat. Required move_type = 1. preference_formula R formula defining linear predictor CTMC habitat-preference (taxis, \(\gamma\)) component. variables must present ctmc_move_dat. Required move_type = 1. ctmc_diffusion_bounds Integer flag. 1 = apply bounds diffusion parameters ensure CTMC generator matrix valid Metzler matrix (non-negative -diagonal entries). 0 = bounds (default). move_timing Integer flag setting movement mortality sequenced within season. 0 = movement mortality (default, historical SPoRC behavior); 1 = mortality movement; 2 = continuous, movement mortality acting simultaneously via matrix exponential \(Q\Delta - \mathrm{diag}(Z)\). move_timing = 2 requires estimated CTMC generator, .e. move_type = 1 use_fixed_movement = 0. ctmc_scale_by_seasdur Integer flag controlling time units CTMC generator. 1 (default) treats \(Q\) annual rate, exponentiating \(Q \cdot \mathrm{seasdur}[s]\) season movement mortality share time units. 0 exponentiates \(Q\) per season regardless duration. effect move_type = 1 n_seas > 1; forced 1 move_timing = 2. move_expm_nsub Integer controlling matrix exponentials CTMC generator evaluated, converting \(Q\) movement fractions inside move_timing = 2 seasonal operators. 0 (default) uses Matrix::expm. power two \(n \ge 1\) instead uses \(n\) implicit (backward Euler) substeps, \((- /n)^{-n}\), evaluated one linear solve plus \(\log_2 n\) squarings, \(n\) must power two. implicit form much cheaper reverse-mode adjoint matrix exponential, gradient several times faster, first-order approximation: \(n = 1\) plain solve(- ) approximation. ... Optional starting value overrides, passed name. Recognized arguments: move_pars Array [n_pop × n_regions × (n_regions-1) × n_years × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0 (equal movement logit scale). log_move_diffusion_pars Vector length n_theta. Default: log(0.1). move_preference_pars Vector length n_gamma. Default: 0. move_devs Array [n_pop × n_regions × (n_regions-1) × (n_years + n_proj_yrs_devs) × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0. move_pe_pars Array [n_pop × n_regions × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes]. Default: 0.

what: Set up survey selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q
title: Set up survey selectivity and catchability specifications — Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q
text: Configures survey selectivity catchability components estimation model: continuous blocked time-varying selectivity, selectivity functional forms, catchability blocks optional environmental covariate effects, process error deviation mapping, selectivity/catchability priors. Delegates parameter mapping four internal helpers (do_fixed_sel_pars_mapping, do_q_mapping, do_sel_pe_pars_mapping, do_sel_devs_mapping). Must called Setup_Mod_SrvIdx_and_Comps model compilation.

Available models (see model equations vignette parameterizations): "logist1" Logistic \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) (2 parameters). "logist2" Logistic \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) (2 parameters). "gamma" Dome-shaped gamma \(a_{max}\) \(\delta\) (2 parameters). "exponential" Exponential single power parameter (1 parameter). "dbnrml" Double-normal 6 parameters. "nonpar" Non-parametric discrete age length bins,     logit scale, mean-standardized jointly years bins     grand mean surface one. Pin one bin, leaving estimated bins,     whenever mean multiplies also free. "asymplogist1" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) slope \(k\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "asymplogist2" Logistic selectivity \(a_{50}\) \(a_{95}\) asymptotic control (3 parameters). "bicubic" Bicubic spline bin-node x year-node grid     (see Get_Selex, Selex_Model == 8). Specified     "bicubic_Bin_<n_bin_nodes>_Yr_<n_yr_nodes>_Fleet_x" (optionally     _Block_k). One generalized form covers smooth bin x year     surface (n_yr_nodes > 1), time-invariant bin-spline     (n_yr_nodes == 1), bin-spline re-fit independently     per year-block (n_yr_nodes == 1 within several blocks     defined via srv_sel_blocks). optional _SelStyr_<year>     suffix (calendar year within block) restricts actual spline     fit SelStyr:block-end; years within block     SelStyr held constant SelStyr year's fitted     curve, rather fitting surface whole block.     optional _NSelBins_<n> suffix restricts actual spline fit     first n bins (ages lengths, per srv_selex_type);     bins beyond n held constant last fitted bin's     curve. default; must provided. title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
text: Configures conventional tagging components estimation model: tag release cohort definitions, recapture data, tag recapture likelihood, mixing period, release platform, dimension-attendance pooling structure, reporting rate time blocks sharing, optional reporting rate priors. Delegates parameter mapping four internal helpers (do_conv_init_tag_mort_mapping, do_conv_tag_shed_mapping, do_conv_tag_theta_mapping, do_conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars_mapping). Must called Setup_Mod_Dim model compilation.

title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
code: Setup_Mod_Tagging(   input_list,   use_conv_fish_tagging = rep(0, input_list$data$n_fish_fleets),   conv_tag_release_indicator = NULL,   conv_tag_max_liberty = 0,   conv_tagged_fish = NA,   obs_conv_tag_fish_recap = NA,   conv_fish_tag_like = NA,   conv_tag_mixing_period = 1,   conv_tag_t_tagging = 1,   use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior = 0,   conv_tag_fishrep_prior = NULL,   conv_tag_pop_pool = as.list(1:input_list$data$n_pop),   conv_tag_age_pool = as.list(1:length(input_list$data$ages)),   conv_tag_sex_pool = as.list(1:input_list$data$n_sexes),   init_conv_tag_mort_spec = NULL,   conv_tag_shed_spec = NULL,   conv_tagrep_spec = "fix",   conv_tag_fish_reporting_blocks = NULL,   conv_fish_tag_attr = "p_a_s",   conv_tag_release_platform = NULL,   ... )

title: Set up the conventional tagging module for model fitting — Setup_Mod_Tagging
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. use_conv_fish_tagging Integer vector [n_fish_fleets] (0/1). Whether conventional tagging data included likelihood fishery fleet. Default: 0 fleets. conv_tag_release_indicator Integer matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 3] giving release region, year, season tag cohort. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Default NULL. conv_tag_max_liberty Integer. Maximum years--liberty included likelihood; recaptures beyond horizon ignored. Must \(> 0\) tagging active. Default 0. conv_tagged_fish Array [n_conv_tag_cohorts × n_pop × n_ages × n_sexes] tagged fish released per cohort. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Dimensions attended conv_fish_tag_attr fish placed index 1 remaining indices set zero. Default NA. obs_conv_tag_fish_recap Array observed recaptures [conv_tag_max_liberty × n_seas × n_conv_tag_cohorts × n_pop × n_regions × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Required use_conv_fish_tagging = 1. Default NA. conv_fish_tag_like Character string specifying tag recapture likelihood. One "Poisson", "NegBin", "Multinomial_Release", "Multinomial_Recapture", "Dirichlet-Multinomial_Release", "Dirichlet-Multinomial_Recapture". Converted integer codes (0-5) storage. Default NA. conv_tag_mixing_period Integer. Minimum number years (seasons seasonal models) post-release recaptures contribute likelihood. Allows time tags mix within population informing movement estimation. Default 1. conv_tag_t_tagging Numeric scalar vector length n_conv_tag_cohorts (one value per row conv_tag_release_indicator), \([0, 1]\). Fraction season remaining tag release release event. 1 = start season; 0.5 = mid-season; 0 = end season. scalar recycled release events. Default 1. use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior Integer (0/1). Whether priors applied reporting rate parameters. Default 0. conv_tag_fishrep_prior Data frame prior specifications reporting rates. Required columns: region, block, fleet, mu, sd, type. Ignored use_conv_tag_fishrep_prior = 0. Default NULL. conv_tag_pop_pool List integer vectors defining population pooling groups tagging likelihood. "p" attended conv_fish_tag_attr, use list(1:n_pop). pooling structure inconsistent conv_fish_tag_attr, warning issued structure automatically overridden single group. Default: .list(1:n_pop) (population-specific). conv_tag_age_pool List integer vectors defining age pooling groups. "" attended, use list(1:n_ages). Custom groupings (e.g., list(1:5, 6:10)) supported "" attended. Default: .list(1:n_ages). conv_tag_sex_pool List integer vectors defining sex pooling groups. "s" attended, use list(1:n_sexes). Default: .list(1:n_sexes). init_conv_tag_mort_spec Character string ("fix", "est_shared", "est_all"). Whether initial tag-induced mortality fixed starting values, estimated single value shared across release events, estimated independently every release event. See do_conv_init_tag_mort_mapping. Default NULL. conv_tag_shed_spec Character string ("fix", "est_shared", "est_all"). Whether chronic tag shedding fixed starting values, estimated single value shared across release events, estimated independently every release event. See do_conv_tag_shed_mapping. Default NULL. conv_tagrep_spec Character string. Sharing structure reporting rate parameters conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars [n_regions × max_tagrep_blocks × n_fish_fleets]. See do_conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars_mapping full option descriptions. Default "fix" (warning issued unintentional). conv_tag_fish_reporting_blocks Character vector defining time blocks fishery tag reporting rates. element follows one : "none_Region_r_Fleet_f" Constant reporting rate     region r fleet f. "Block_b_Year_y1-y2_Region_r_Fleet_f" Block b     applies years y1-y2. Use "terminal"     end year extend final model year. Parsed array [n_regions × n_years × n_fish_fleets]. NULL, single constant block used region-fleet combinations. Default NULL. conv_fish_tag_attr Character scalar character vector length n_conv_tag_cohorts specifying biological dimensions attended (resolved) release tag release event. scalar recycled every event; vector lets different events resolve different dimensions (e.g. event 1 known "p_a_s", event 2 "p_a"). element built combination "p" (population), "" (age), "s" (sex), joined underscores. Region fleet always retained. dimension attended event, released fish event placed index 1 dimension apportioned full resolution via release platform. dimension may split one pooling group attended every release event; otherwise corresponding pooling argument overridden single group (warning). Valid values: "p_a_s", "a_s", "p_a", "p_s", "", "s", "p", "none". Default "p_a_s". conv_tag_release_platform Character matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 2] specifying release platform fleet index per cohort. format Setup_Sim_Tagging. Default NULL. ... Optional named starting values parameters. Supported names defaults: ln_init_conv_tag_mort (scalar length n_conv_tag_cohorts   vector; scalar recycled release events; default   -1000), ln_conv_tag_shed (scalar length n_conv_tag_cohorts   vector; scalar recycled release events; default   -1000), ln_conv_fish_tag_theta (scalar, default 0), conv_tag_fish_reporting_pars   [n_regions × max_tagrep_blocks × n_fish_fleets], default 0 (logit scale ≈ 0.5 reporting probability; inactive fleet slots overwritten -1000).

title: Set likelihood and penalty weights for the estimation model — Setup_Mod_Weighting
text: input_list Named list $data, $par, $map, $verbose sublists, returned upstream setup functions. addtocomp Small constant added composition proportions likelihood evaluation avoid log(0). Default 1e-3. Ignored logistic-normal likelihood specified, family handles zeros internally. comp_const_obs Integer switch (0 1) controlling addtocomp applied multinomial likelihood, constant tuned. 1 (default) adds observed proportions weight multinomial well inside logarithms, likelihood stationary exactly pred = obs. 0 weights raw observed proportions. fishery survey conditional age--length fleet uses Dirichlet-Multinomial, 1 triggers warning, since added constant biases theta upward age bins length bin structurally empty. addtofishidx Small constant added fishery indices. Default 1e-4. addtosrvidx Small constant added survey indices. Default 1e-4. addtotag Small constant added tag recovery observations. Default 1e-10. Wt_Catch Weight applied catch likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly across fleets, regions, years, seasons, numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets] fleet- time-specific weighting. Default 1. Wt_FishIdx Weight applied fishery index likelihood. Accepts scalar array format Wt_Catch, dimensioned [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_SrvIdx Weight applied survey index likelihood. Accepts scalar array format, dimensioned [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_srv_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Catch_pop Weight applied population-specific catch likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_FishIdx_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery index likelihood. scalar array format Wt_Catch_pop, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_SrvIdx_pop Weight applied population-specific survey index likelihood. scalar array format Wt_Catch_pop, dimensioned [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_srv_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Rec Weight applied recruitment deviation penalty (ln_RecDevs). Either scalar applied uniformly numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_est_rec_devs] deviation-specific weighting, n_est_rec_devs third dimension ln_RecDevs rather number years, since dont_est_recdev_last n_proj_yrs_devs move . Default 1. weight zero deviation leaves estimated removes penalty entirely, stock-recruit relationship fit window years recruitment stays free every year. distinct dont_est_recdev_last, removes deviations recruitment reverts deterministic prediction years. Wt_Init_Rec Weight applied initial age deviation penalty (ln_InitDevs). Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × (n_ages - 1) × n_sexes]. Defaults NULL, takes whatever Wt_Rec Wt_Rec scalar; supply explicitly Wt_Rec array, since two penalties dimensioned differently. Wt_F Scalar weight applied fishing mortality deviation penalty (ln_F_devs). Default 1. Wt_Tagging Scalar weight applied tag-recovery likelihood. Default 1. Wt_FishAgeComps Weight applied fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvAgeComps Weight applied survey age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps Weight applied fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvLenComps Weight applied survey length composition likelihood. format Wt_SrvAgeComps, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishAgeComps_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvAgeComps_pop Weight applied population-specific survey age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_pop Weight applied population-specific fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_SrvLenComps_pop Weight applied population-specific survey length composition likelihood. format Wt_SrvAgeComps_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_Discard Weight applied aggregated discard amount fraction likelihood. Either scalar applied uniformly numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_Discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_fish_fleets]. Default 1. Wt_D Scalar weight applied discard mortality rate deviation penalty (logit_dmr_devs). Default 1. Wt_FishAgeComps_discard Weight applied discard fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_discard Weight applied discard fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_discard, [n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishAgeComps_discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard fishery age composition likelihood. Either scalar numeric array [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_FishLenComps_discard_pop Weight applied population-specific discard fishery length composition likelihood. format Wt_FishAgeComps_discard_pop, [n_pop × n_regions × n_years × n_seas × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets]. Default: array 1s. Wt_Fish_caal Weight applied fishery conditional age--length likelihood, multiplying input sample size length bin's age composition. Array [n_regions x n_years x n_seas x n_lens x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets], shape ISS_Fish_caal. Defaults one everywhere. Wt_Srv_caal Weight applied survey conditional age--length likelihood. format Wt_Fish_caal, n_srv_fleets last dimension. Defaults one everywhere. fish_sel_pen_wts NULL (default), named numeric vector/list independent weights subset six selectivity smoothness penalty terms (see resolve_sel_pen_wts Get_Selex_Smoothness_Penalty), evaluated directly fleet's realized selectivity--bin--year surface applicable selectivity functional form: "smooth_bin_curve" Second-difference (curvature) penalty across bins. "smooth_bin_diff" Unconditional first-difference penalty across bins. "smooth_yr_diff" First-difference penalty across years. "smooth_yr_curve" Second-difference (curvature) penalty across years. "smooth_dome" Dome-shape (non-monotonicity) penalty across bins. "smooth_mean_center" Per-year mean-centering regularization. name supplied defaults 0 (). Must called Setup_Mod_Fishsel_and_Q. weight may instead vector one value per model year, penalty can act years different strength . specification may also carry "bin_range", length-two vector giving first last bin penalties act . give fleet penalties, pass unnamed list one named specification per fleet instead single specification. ret_sel_pen_wts format fish_sel_pen_wts, retained fishery selectivity penalty. srv_sel_pen_wts format fish_sel_pen_wts, survey selectivity penalty. Must called Setup_Mod_Srvsel_and_Q.

code: Setup_Sim_Biologicals(   sim_list,   natmort_input,   WAA_input,   WAA_fish_input,   WAA_srv_input,   MatAA_input,   AgeingError_input = NULL,   AgeingError_fish_input = NULL,   AgeingError_srv_input = NULL,   SizeAgeTrans_input = NULL,   SizeAgeTrans_fish_input = NULL,   SizeAgeTrans_srv_input = NULL )

title: Set up biological parameter inputs for closed-loop simulation — Setup_Sim_Biologicals
text: sim_list Simulation list object returned Setup_Sim_Dim, defines dimension sizes used validate input arrays. natmort_input Natural mortality array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Note: natural mortality season-specific therefore lacks n_seas dimension. WAA_input Spawning weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Used compute spawning stock biomass. WAA_fish_input Fishery weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_fish_fleets × n_sims]. Used compute fishery biomass catch weight. WAA_srv_input Survey weight--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_srv_fleets × n_sims]. Used compute survey biomass indices. MatAA_input Maturity--age array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. Values proportions \([0, 1]\). rec_lag = 0 (age-0 recruitment, set via Setup_Sim_Rec), maturity recruit age (first age class) must exactly 0 populations, regions, years, seasons, sexes. error raised otherwise. AgeingError_input Ageing error (age-length transition) array dimensions [n_yrs × n_model_ages × n_obs_ages × n_sims], [n_model_ages × n_obs_ages] slice row-stochastic matrix mapping true modeled ages observed age bins. NULL (default), identity matrix constructed year simulation, assumes modeled observed age bins identical number alignment. observed age bins subset modeled ages (e.g., observed ages 2-10 vs. modeled ages 1-10), default identity matrix cause dimensional mismatch. case, supply shifted identity matrix diag(1, n_model_ages)[, obs_age_index] correctly drop collapse model ages observed bins. AgeingError_fish_input Optional fleet-specific ageing error simulated fishery fleets, dimensioned [n_yrs × n_ages × n_obs_ages × n_fish_fleets × n_sims], NULL (default) give every fishery fleet AgeingError_input. AgeingError_srv_input Optional fleet-specific ageing error simulated survey fleets, dimensioned [n_yrs × n_ages × n_obs_ages × n_srv_fleets × n_sims], NULL (default) give every survey fleet AgeingError_input. SizeAgeTrans_input Size-age transition matrix array dimensions [n_pop × n_regions × n_yrs × n_seas × n_lens × n_ages × n_sexes × n_sims]. slice maps age classes length bins column-stochastic (columns sum 1). required fitting length compositions; defaults NULL. SizeAgeTrans_fish_input, SizeAgeTrans_srv_input Optional size-age transition arrays per fleet, [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_lens x n_ages x n_sexes x n_fleets x n_sims], read fleet's timing. supplied used fleet type place SizeAgeTrans_input; self-test passes fitted model's keys growth estimated.

title: Initialize simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
text: Creates foundational sim_list object used throughout closed-loop simulation static simulation. downstream setup functions (Setup_Sim_Biologicals, Setup_Sim_Containers, etc.) expect sim_list produced function. Dimension scalars validated input stored alongside derived quantities init_iter natal_region mapping.

title: Initialize simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
code: Setup_Sim_Dim(   n_sims,   n_yrs,   n_pop = 1,   n_seas = 1,   n_regions,   natal_region = NULL,   n_ages,   n_lens = NULL,   n_obs_ages = n_ages,   n_sexes,   n_fish_fleets,   n_srv_fleets,   seasdur = if (n_seas == 1) 1 else rep(1/n_seas, n_seas),   run_feedback = FALSE,   feedback_start_yr = NULL )

title: Initialize simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
text: n_sims Positive integer. Number simulation replicates. n_yrs Positive integer. Number projection years. n_pop Positive integer. Number distinct populations (default 1). Populations share movement selectivity schedules can independent stock-recruit relationships natal regions. n_seas Positive integer. Number seasons within year (default 1). n_regions Positive integer. Number spatial regions. natal_region Integer vector length n_pop mapping population natal region (1-indexed). Defaults applied NULL: n_regions == 1: populations assigned region 1. n_pop == n_regions: one--one mapping (1:n_pop). n_pop == 1: assigned region 1. Must supplied explicitly n_pop > 1, n_pop != n_regions, n_regions > 1, multiple populations share natal region sensible default exists. n_ages Positive integer. Number modeled age classes. n_lens Positive integer. Number length bins. Set NULL (default) length compositions simulated. n_obs_ages Positive integer. Number observed age bins composition data. Can differ n_ages plus group youngest ages pooled differently observations. Defaults n_ages. n_sexes Integer. Number sexes; must either 1 (sex-aggregated) 2 (sex-structured). n_fish_fleets Positive integer. Number fishery fleets. n_srv_fleets Positive integer. Number survey fleets. seasdur Numeric vector length n_seas giving duration season fraction year. Values must sum 1. Defaults 1 n_seas == 1, rep(1 / n_seas, n_seas) equal-length seasons otherwise. run_feedback Logical. Whether run closed-loop feedback MSE estimation model harvest control rule update fishing mortality year. Default FALSE (open-loop simulation). feedback_start_yr Integer. First year feedback applied. Required run_feedback = TRUE; ignored otherwise.

title: Initialize simulation dimension settings — Setup_Sim_Dim
text: named list (sim_list) containing: n_sims, n_yrs, n_pop, n_regions,       n_seas, n_ages, n_obs_ages, n_lens,       n_sexes, n_fish_fleets, n_srv_fleets Dimension scalars supplied inputs. natal_region Integer vector length n_pop       defining natal regions. seasdur Season durations summing 1. init_iter Derived value n_ages * 10 used initialize       equilibrium conditions. run_feedback, feedback_start_yr Feedback control settings.

title: Setup Simulation Fishing Inputs — Setup_Sim_Fishing
text: sim_list list containing simulation settings, including number populations (`n_pop`), regions (`n_regions`), years (`n_yrs`), seasons (`n_seas`), ages (`n_ages`), sexes (`n_sexes`), fishing fleets (`n_fish_fleets`), simulations (`n_sims`). ln_sigmaC Numeric array. Log-scale observation SD total catch, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(0.02). ln_sigmaC_pop Numeric array. Log-scale observation SD population-specific catch, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: log(0.02). ln_sigmaCAA, ln_sigmaDAA Log-scale observation error -age streams, `n_ages x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets`. array without sex margin required. UseCatchAA, UseDiscardAA Integer arrays `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_ages x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets`, `1` -age observation drawn. sex margin required: stream summed sexes carries flag sex slot one. ObsCatchAA_SE, ObsDiscardAA_SE Reported standard errors shaped like use arrays, read stream's `sigma_form` asks . CatchAA_Type, DiscardAA_Type margins fleet reports separately: `"agg"`, `"spltRaggS"` (default), `"aggRspltS"` `"spltRspltS"`. summed margin drawn , slot one. CatchAA_LikeType, DiscardAA_LikeType `"lognormal"` (default) `"normal"`, per fleet. CatchAA_sigma_form, DiscardAA_sigma_form observation error comes : `"none"` (default), `"data"`, `"est_additive"` `"est_quadrature"`. use_catch_aa, use_discard_aa Integer vectors `n_fish_fleets`, `1` fleets whose -age streams drawn. catch_units Numeric vector. Catch units (0 = abundance, 1 = biomass), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 1. init_F_val Numeric array. Initial fishing mortality, dimensions `n_regions x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. Fmort_input Numeric array. Fishing mortality, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 0.1. fish_sel_input Numeric array. Fishery selectivity, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_ages x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. fish_q_input Numeric array. Catchability, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. Default: 1. ObsFishIdx_SE Numeric array. Observation SD fishery indices, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.2. ObsFishIdx_pop_SE Numeric array. Observation SD population-specific fishery indices, dimensions `n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0.2. fish_idx_type Numeric array. Index type (0 = abundance, 1 = biomass), dimensions `n_regions x n_fish_fleets`. Default: 1. FishIdx_LikeType Character numeric vector, length `n_fish_fleets`. Error structure fleet's index drawn : "lognormal" (0), "normal" (1), "mvn" (2), matching estimation model's FishIdx_LikeType. mvn fleet draws FishIdx_Cov common-factor decomposition (see cov_to_factor) instead ObsFishIdx_SE, population-specific stream stays lognormal. Default: lognormal every fleet. FishIdx_Cov List one element per fishery fleet holding fixed covariance fleet's fitted index observations, ordered scanning UseFishIdx array order (region fastest, year, season). Required mvn fleets. Default: NULL. UseFishIdx Numeric array [n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] fit flags estimation model, used position simulated cell covariance. year dimension may shorter simulation, case later years draw mean factor scale loading. Required mvn fleets. Default: NULL. t_fish Numeric array [n_regions x n_seas x n_fish_fleets] giving fishery index timing, fraction season elapsed index observed. Numbers age decayed exp(-t_fish * ZAA) index formed, matching t_srv surveys estimation model's t_fish. Defaults 0 (start season). comp_fish_caal_like Character numeric vector `n_fish_fleets` giving conditional age--length likelihood per fleet: `"Multinomial"` (0), `"Dirichlet-Multinomial"` (1), `"none"` (999). two families exist CAAL: CAAL row age composition otoliths taken one length bin, usually small mostly zero sample, logistic-normal forms support. Default: `"none"` every fleet. ISS_Fish_caal Numeric array. Number fish aged within length bin, dimensions `n_regions x n_yrs x n_seas x n_lens x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets x n_sims`. bin whose sample size rounds zero skipped. `NULL` (default) draws CAAL; supplying alongside likelihood `"none"` switches `do_fish_caal` . Requires `n_lens`. ln_Fish_caal_theta Numeric array. Log overdispersion Dirichlet-multinomial, dimensions `n_regions x n_sexes x n_fish_fleets`. Read split types, `[r, s, f]` sexes split `[r, 1, f]` joint, ignored multinomial. Default: log(1). ln_Fish_caal_theta_agg Numeric vector `n_fish_fleets`. aggregated type's counterpart `ln_Fish_caal_theta`. Default: log(1). Fish_caal_Type Numeric character array giving composition structure per year fleet, dimensions `n_yrs x n_fish_fleets`: `"agg"` (0) pools regions sexes drawn region loop reaches last region, `"spltRspltS"` (1) draws sex bin sample, `"spltRjntS"` (2) draws one sample across age sex stack, `"none"` (999) skips fleet year. Unlike estimation model, parses `"CompType_Year_x-y_Fleet_z"` strings, simulator takes year fleet array directly. Default: `"none"` throughout. comp_fishage_like Numeric vector. Likelihood age composition (0 = Multinomial, 1 = Dirichlet-Multinomial, 2-4 = Logistic-Normal variants), length `n_fish_fleets`. Default: 0. ISS_FishAgeComps Numeric array. text: sim_list Simulation list returned Setup_Sim_Dim. do_recruits_move Integer flag. 0 = age-1 fish move (default); movement begins age 2. 1 = recruits participate movement age 1. sexratio_input Proportion recruits assigned sex, array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sexes x n_sims].
