Default: 15 cells. rinit_input Unfished equilibrium recruitment scalar used population initialization use_rinit = 1, array [n_pop x n_regions x n_sims]. Ignored use_rinit = 0. Default: 15 cells. h_input Beverton-Holt steepness array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sims]. Values \((0.2, 1)\). Default: 0.8. stray_rate_input Natal-homing stray rate array [n_pop x n_yrs x n_sims]. Proportion individuals stray natal region spawning. Default: 0 (individuals stray). ln_sigmaR Log-scale standard deviation recruitment deviations, array [2 x n_pop x n_regions]. first element controls SD initial age-structure deviations (ln_InitDevs); second controls SD annual recruitment deviations (ln_RecDevs). Default: log(1) . rec_seas_prop_input Seasonal allocation annual recruitment, array [n_pop x n_seas x n_sims]. population's values sum 1 across seasons. Default: recruitment assigned season 1. rec_lag = 0 spawn_seas > 1, must zero every season spawn_seas. error raised otherwise. recruitment_opt Recruitment model. Default "bh_rec". Options: 0/"mean_rec" Mean recruitment; stock-recruit     relationship. 1/"bh_rec" Beverton-Holt stock-recruit relationship.     Requires rec_dd = "local" n_pop > 1. 999/"resample_from_input" Bootstrap recruitment     resampling years Rec_input. Historical years used     -; projection years sampled replacement, preserving     spatial covariance among regions within resampled year.     Requires Rec_input non-NULL. rec_dd Density-dependence structure stock-recruit relationship. Default "global". Options: 0/"local" Region-specific spawner-recruit     relationship; region \(R_0\) steepness.     Required n_pop > 1 recruitment_opt = "bh_rec". 1/"global" Single shared spawner-recruit     relationship pooled across regions. init_dd Density-dependence structure equilibrium age-structure initialization. Default "global". options rec_dd. use_rinit Integer (0/1). Whether separate initial recruitment scalar rinit_input used initialize population independently R0_input. 0 (default), rinit_input ignored R0_input governs initialization recruitment. 1, rinit_input used exclusively equilibrium initialization R0_input governs recruitment relationship. init_age_strc Integer specifying equilibrium age-structure initialization method. Default 2. Options: 0/"iterative" Iterates population forward     approximate equilibrium. Slowest general. 1/"scalar_no_move" Scalar geometric series solution     assuming movement age class. 2/"matrix" Matrix geometric series solution     generalizes scalar approach include movement. Recommended     default spatially explicit models. 3/"scalar_plus_only" Scalar geometric series     solution assuming movement except plus group. 4/"free" equilibrium projected :     ln_InitDevs initial log numbers--age     ages 2 , apportioned sex ratio, age 1 still taken     recruitment. Use assessment estimates initial     numbers--age freely rather departures equilibrium.     initial condition depend init_F_par     ln_rinit, deviations log-numbers rather     log-ratios, penalty acts prior initial abundance:     pair equil_init_age_strc = "equil" prior,     InitDevs_pen_center = "own_mean" penalize     roughness age structure level. spawn_seas Integer index season spawning occurs. Default 1. t_spawn Spawn timing fraction season elapsed spawning within spawn_seas. 0 (default) = spawning occurs mortality applied season; 1 = spawning occurs mortality. rec_lag Integer. Number seasons spawning recruitment. 1 (default) classic lagged case: recruits enter population using SSB rec_lag seasons prior, season. 0 age-0 recruitment: recruits enter using year's SSB. SSB known spawn_seas reached, age-0 recruits may enter spawn_seas later season year; rec_seas_prop_input must zero every season spawn_seas rec_lag = 0. Rec_input External recruitment array [n_pop x n_regions x n_yrs x n_sims]. Required recruitment_opt = "resample_from_input"; projection years beyond length Rec_input filled resampling historical years replacement. Ignored recruitment options. Default NULL. ln_InitDevs_input Optional log-scale initial age-structure deviations array, either [n_pop x n_regions x (n_ages - 1) x n_sims] (one shared curve, broadcast across sexes) [n_pop x n_regions x (n_ages - 1) x n_sexes x n_sims] (one curve per sex). n_ages - 1 dimension excludes reference age used initialization. NULL (default), deviations drawn one shared curve per population region. InitDevs_sex_spec Character. initial age deviations drawn across sexes supplied ln_InitDevs_input. "est_shared_s" (default) draws one curve per population region gives every sex. "est_all" draws sex . Departures initial equilibrium reflect exploitation stock already seen well year-class strength, sex-specific selectivity natural mortality two sexes need departed amount, case "est_all" covers. names match InitDevs_sex_spec Setup_Mod_Rec, operating model estimation model fitted can set way.

title: Set up conventional tagging dynamics for the operating model simulation — Setup_Sim_Tagging
text: sim_list Simulation list returned Setup_Sim_Dim. n_tags Numeric scalar. Constant number tags released per release event. specified simultaneously n_tags_rel_input. Default NULL. n_tags_rel_input Array specifying cohort-specific tag release numbers (e.g., varying length, age, structure). Overrides n_tags supplied. specified simultaneously n_tags. Default NULL. use_conv_fish_tagging Integer (0/1). Whether conventional tag recaptures fisheries simulated. Default 0. conv_tag_max_liberty Integer. Maximum number years--liberty tracked per tag cohort. Controls size recapture containers. Default: n_ages / 2. conv_tag_release_indicator Data frame defining tag release cohorts. Required columns: regions (release region), tag_years (release year), tag_seas (release season). Default: combinations regions, years, seasons sim_list. conv_tag_release_platform Character matrix [n_conv_tag_cohorts × 2] specifying release platform associated fleet index cohort. Rows must align conv_tag_release_indicator. Column platform must one : "population" Tags released directly population,     independent fleet survey sampling process.     fleet column NA. "fishery" Tags released fishery fleet.     fleet column gives fleet index. "survey" Tags released survey fleet.     fleet column gives fleet index. Default: "survey" platform fleet 1 every cohort. conv_tag_t_tagging Numeric scalar vector length n_tag_rel_events (one value per row conv_tag_release_indicator), \([0, 1]\). Fraction season remaining time tag release release event. 1 = start season; 0.5 = mid-season; 0 = end season. scalar recycled release events. Default 1. ln_init_conv_tag_mort Log-scale initial tag-induced mortality applied moment release. Numeric scalar vector length n_tag_rel_events, one value per release event. scalar recycled release events. Default -1000 (approximately zero mortality). ln_conv_tag_shed Log-scale annual chronic tag shedding rate. Numeric scalar vector length n_tag_rel_events, one value per release event. scalar recycled release events. Default -1000 (approximately shedding). conv_fish_tag_attr Character scalar character vector length n_tag_rel_events specifying biological dimensions resolved release (hence retained recapture) tag release event. scalar recycled every event; vector lets different events resolve different dimensions (e.g. event 1 known "p_a_s", event 2 "p_a"). element built combination "p" (population), "" (age), "s" (sex), joined underscores. Region fleet always retained. Valid values: "p_a_s", "a_s", "p_a", "p_s", "", "s", "p", "none". Default "p_a_s". conv_tag_fish_reporting_input Fishery tag reporting rate array [n_regions × n_yrs × n_fish_fleets × n_sims]. Values represent probability recaptured tag reported must \([0, 1]\). Default: 0.5 cells. conv_fish_tag_like Integer character scalar specifying tag recapture likelihood. Default 0 (Poisson). Options: 0/"Poisson" Poisson. 1/"NegBin" Negative binomial. 2/"Multinomial_Release" Multinomial conditioned     releases. 3/"Multinomial_Recapture" Multinomial conditioned     recaptures. 4/"Dirichlet-Multinomial_Release" Dirichlet-multinomial     conditioned releases. 5/"Dirichlet-Multinomial_Recapture" Dirichlet-multinomial     conditioned recaptures. ln_conv_fish_tag_theta Log-scale overdispersion parameter negative-binomial (1) Dirichlet-multinomial (4, 5) likelihoods. Ignored Poisson multinomial likelihoods. Default log(1).

text: integral runs unit interval, \([0, \Delta]\), \(= Q^\top \Delta - \mathrm{diag}(Z)\) already carries season duration terms. integration variable elapsed fraction season, full season \(\tau = 1\). Van Loan's block identity $$\exp\left(\begin{bmatrix} & \\ 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\right) =       \begin{bmatrix} e^{} & \int_0^1 e^{\tau}d\tau \\ 0 & \end{bmatrix}$$ recovers integral single matrix exponential twice dimension. preferred \(^{-1}(e^{} - )\) avoids explicit inverse stays well conditioned \(\) approaches singularity. edge case : generator zero eigenvalue (rows sum zero), \(\) becomes exactly singular total mortality approaches zero, precisely integral remains perfectly well behaved.

title: Compute local Beverton-Holt Fmsy for a spatially explicit multi-population model — local_Fmsy_multipop
text: Cohorts tracked using per-recruit framework indexed [population x origin x destination x age x season]. Recruitment distributed across seasons (rec_seas_prop), regions (rec_region_prop), sex (sex_ratio_f). Initial recruits assigned first season age-1, additional seasonal recruitment contributions added within first age class prior movement mortality. Movement applied seasonal step using region- age-specific transition matrices. Fishing mortality decomposed retained discarded components, total mortality applied continuously within season. Catch--age accumulated across fleets, seasons, regions using landed fraction fishing mortality (excluding fleets flagged discard-via is_discard_fleet), total mortality Z includes fleets. Spawning biomass per recruit (SBPR) computed spawning season applying movement partial mortality spawning time (t_spawn). single-season models multiple populations, sgl_seas_spawning_movement redistributes individuals natal spawning regions prior SSB calculation. plus group solved analytically using build_plus_group_T solve_plus_group, ensuring consistent equilibrium solution terminal age class. Effective spawning biomass population's natal region includes contributions populations via straying. Stray contributions scaled stray_rate normalized n_pop_in_region preserve mass balance. Equilibrium recruitment population obtained via Newton-Raphson algorithm solves coupled Beverton-Holt system. Jacobian accounts cross-population dependence spawning biomass induced straying. Total equilibrium yield computed integrating catch--age populations, regions, seasons, scaled equilibrium recruitment origin-region proportions. Recruitment implemented per-recruit process later scaled equilibrium recruitment. Seasonal recruitment proportions applied within first age class, allowing intra-annual timing recruitment movement mortality applied. objective function negative total yield, summed across populations regions. Yield includes landings fleets is_discard_fleet == 0; discard-fleets contribute mortality yield maximized.

title: Compute region-specific Beverton-Holt Fmsy for a spatially explicit single-population model — local_Fmsy_sglpop
text: Cohorts originating region tracked separately seasonal movement, mortality, ageing using [origin, destination] per-recruit accounting framework. Spawning biomass per recruit accumulated origin destination region, plus group solved analytically using build_plus_group_T solve_plus_group. Equilibrium recruitment origin region \(R_{eq,o}\) solved using Newton-Raphson algorithm applied fixed-point condition recruitment produced destination region (via BH relationship applied effective SSB) equals recruitment attributed origin. Jacobian derived analytically using quotient rule chain rule spatial redistribution spawning biomass. Yield computed using landed fraction fishing mortality, excluding fleets flagged discard-via is_discard_fleet. Discard-fleets still contribute total mortality Z affect population dynamics spawning biomass. Fishing mortality decomposed retained discarded components: Retained fishing mortality:     $$F^{\mathrm{ret}}_{r,,s,f} = F_{MSY,r} \, F_{\mathrm{fract},r,s,f} \,           \mathrm{sel}_{r,,s,f} \, \mathrm{ret}_{r,,s,f}$$ Discard fishing mortality (dead discards ):     $$F^{\mathrm{disc}}_{r,,s,f} =           F_{MSY,r} \, F_{\mathrm{fract},r,s,f} \,           \mathrm{sel}_{r,,s,f} \, (1 - \mathrm{ret}_{r,,s,f}) \,           \mathrm{dmr}_{r,s,f}$$ Total instantaneous mortality:     $$Z_{r,,s} = M_{r,} \, \mathrm{seasdur}_s +           F^{\mathrm{ret}}_{r,,s} + F^{\mathrm{disc}}_{r,,s}$$ Landed yield used objective function excludes catch fleets is_discard_fleet == 1. Baranov catch equation partitions landed F total Z, discard fleet's contribution mortality properly accounted denominator. Seasonal movement applied using Movement[origin, dest, seas, age] array. Recruitment may move immediately age-1 depending do_recruits_move. Spawning biomass accumulated spawn_seas fractional mortality t_spawn. plus group solved analytically using transition matrices produced build_plus_group_T solver solve_plus_group.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Added population-specific (natal homing) seasonal dynamics simulation estimation. dimensions now follow population, region, year, season, age, sex, fleet. Added movement--mortality continuous movement dynamics. Added continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) movement estimation using preference functions. Added move_expm_nsub Setup_Mod_Movement, allowing CTMC matrix exponentials evaluated using implicit backward Euler substeps, providing faster alternative differentiation preserving non-negative fractions exact survivor catch balance. Added support local density dependence reference points meta-population natal homing models. Added uncertainty estimation reference points.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Added population-specific catches, indices, compositions, tagging data, discards, discarded compositions simulation estimation. Recoded tagging allow fleet-specific reporting rates missing attributes tagged fish. conv_tag_t_tagging, ln_init_conv_tag_mort, ln_conv_tag_shed now per-release-event vectors rather global scalars; scalars remain supported recycled. init_conv_tag_mort_spec/conv_tag_shed_spec accept "fix", "est_shared", "est_all". Added internal OSA residuals catch, indices, compositions, tagging data. Added support -age data streams (e.g., ICES-style stock assessments). Survey fleets can observe recruitment deviations directly via srv_idx_type = "recdev", reported RecDev_anom.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Added age-0 (rec_lag = 0) Beverton-Holt recruitment, driven year’s SSB. Added sr_penalty ("none", "bh", "ricker") fit stock-recruit relationship penalty rather recruitment process . sr_R0_spec controls scale stock-recruit curve. MSY reference points remain unavailable mean recruitment. Added Fdev_model ("iid", "rw", "ar1") Setup_Mod_Catch_and_F, Fdev_rho/Fdev_rho_spec AR1 case. Fishing mortality deviations now distinguish missing catch observations true recorded zeros: NA ObsCatch UseCatch == 0 estimates F active year, whereas observed zero forces Fmort zero. Added ability parameterize fishing mortality free annual log-F via ln_F_mean_spec = "fix".

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Growth parameters can vary time via growth_tv_model ("iid"/"rw"), support year- cohort-specific variation. Added semi-parametric growth (growth_semipar: "iid", "rw", "2dar1", "3dmarg", "3dcond") year--age deviations mean length age. Added Richards growth form (growth_model = "richards"), von Bertalanffy growth recovered rho = 1. Added flexible size-age weight--age inputs, including fleet-specific size-age keys selection-weighted weight age. Added conditional age--length fitting Francis reweighting.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Added non-parametric, bicubic, logistic--asymptote, fixed selectivity forms. Added sex-specific selectivity offsets, allowing selectivity parameters linked across sexes using "par", "scale", "par_scale", "apical", "par_apical" forms. Added time-, bin-, surface-based selectivity deviations expanded selectivity smoothness penalties. Corrected double-normal ("dbnrml") selectivity parameterization added flexible anchoring ascending limb. Added _NSelBins_<n> suffixes selectivity model strings hold bins beyond n value bin n. Added fish_sel_norm_bins/srv_sel_norm_bins specify bins non-parametric log-scale selectivity standardized.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Reference points now support local density dependence meta-population natal homing models. Added uncertainty estimation reference points. Get_Reference_Points now uses growth-derived weight age model report rather data placeholder.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Added BSAI Atka mackerel, West Coast sablefish, EBS Pacific cod, North Sea sand eel, GOA Rex Sole, BSAI Northern Rock Sole case studies bridging recent assessments.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Improved Newton refinement fit_model obtaining Hessian directly AD tape rather finite differencing. Added 95% confidence intervals SDNR based chi-squared test OSA residuals. Added OSA residuals time-series observations, compositions, tagging data.

title: version 1.2.0.9000 (dev-popn-seasons)
text: Numeric character codes accepted simulator dynamics, matching estimation model. Added shared process-error sharing-spec helper (build_pe_map/build_shared_spec_map); migrated sigmaF_spec, sigmaC_spec, sigmaR_spec, Fdev_rho_spec, do_Fmort_mapping onto (developers). Refactored movement’s continuous process-error map log-likelihood onto shared machinery (developers). Newton refinement fit_model now takes Hessian AD tape (obj$) instead finite-differencing, stops early non-finite Hessian.
